name: taskquest-application
description: TaskQuest: a gamified task manager delivered as a Discord bot and a web dashboard sharing one database.

scripts.lint: npm run lint -w @taskquest/web && npm run lint:node
scripts.lint:node: eslint -c eslint.config.node.mjs apps/bot apps/server packages/shared scripts
scripts.db:reset: docker compose down -v && docker compose up -d --wait db
scripts.test:db: echo "Run npm run db:up, then: TEST_DB_PASSWORD=taskquest-dev TEST_DB_NAME=taskquest_test npm test (that database is WIPED)"
